symptoms.symptom: Dryer doesn’t start

causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: House Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Most electric dryers use two fuses/breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "House Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Dryer fuse blown
remedies: The single (Gas) or one of the two (Electric) fuses in the rear of the backsplash blew because the house circuit protection didn’t work.
Have a qualified technician check for power at outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Dryer fuse blown"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer doesn’t heat

causes.label: House Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker is tripped.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "House Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Gas service is off
remedies: Make sure gas shutoff at dryer and main shutoff are fully open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Gas service is off"

causes.label: No heat temperature selected
remedies: Select another heat setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "No heat temperature selected"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer shakes or makes noise

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly"

symptoms.symptom: Greasy spots on clothes

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Drying dirty items with clean ones
remedies: Use your dryer to dry only clean items.
Dirty items can stain clean items and the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Drying dirty items with clean ones"

causes.label: Clothes were not completely clean
remedies: Sometimes stains which cannot be seen when the clothes are wet appear after drying.
Use proper washing procedures before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Clothes were not completely clean"

symptoms.symptom: Lint on clothes

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under Static occurs.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Overloading"

symptoms.symptom: Static occurs

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Over-drying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust setting to Less Dry or Damp.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Over-drying"

causes.label: Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static"

symptoms.symptom: Inconsistent drying times

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies: Automatic drying times will vary according to the type of heat used (electric, natural or LP gas), size of load, types of fabrics, wetness of clothes and condition of exhaust ducts.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Type of heat"

symptoms.symptom: The Dry dryness level was chosen but load is still damp

causes.label: Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics
remedies: When combining heavy and light fabrics in a load, choose More Dry if you are using a sensor cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics"

causes.label: Exhaust system is blocked
remedies: Inspect and clean exhaust system.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Exhaust system is blocked"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check installation instructions for proper ducting/venting.
Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.
Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker
remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.
Electric dryers use 2 fuses/breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies: Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Under-loading
remedies: If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Under-loading"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes are wrinkled

causes.label: Over-drying
remedies: Select a shorter drying time.
Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
Select a Less Dry or Damp Dry setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Over-drying"

causes.label: Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends
remedies: Remove items when cycle ends and fold or hang immediately.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Overloading"

symptoms.symptom: Water seen on inside of door and top of lint filter when opening door after steam cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on these surfaces
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Steam condenses on these surfaces"

symptoms.symptom: Collars and waistbands still wet at end of cycle

causes.label: The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry
remedies: Choose Speed Dry or Timed Dry to dry damp collars and waistbands.
In the future, when drying a load with collars and waistbands, choose More Dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry"

symptoms.symptom: Slight variation in metallic color

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Due to the metallic properties of paint used for this unique product, slight variations of color may occur due to viewing angles and lighting conditions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Small amount of water on floor in front of dryer

causes.label: Inadequate load size for steam cycle selected, excess steam condenses inside cabinet and leaks out
remedies: If using the Steam Dewrinkle cycle, manually reduce time or select fewer number of garments with Steam Select.
If using the Steam Refresh cycle, add more garments to the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Inadequate load size for steam cycle selected, excess steam condenses inside cabinet and leaks out"

symptoms.symptom: Water on floor in back of dryer

causes.label: Loose water hose connection to valve
remedies: Tighten connection.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Loose water hose connection to valve"

causes.label: Hose missing rubber washer at connection with valve
remedies: Install rubber washer provided with hose.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Hose missing rubber washer at connection with valve"

symptoms.symptom: Water drips from door when opened after a Steam Cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on inner door
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Steam condenses on inner door"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot see steam at beginning of cycle

causes.label: Steam released at different time in cycle
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Steam released at different time in cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot see steam at any time during the cycle

causes.label: The steam nozzle might be clogged with debris from your water supply
remedies: Call 800.GE.CARES to order nozzle replacement kit WE25M71 or to request a service technician to replace this for you.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "The steam nozzle might be clogged with debris from your water supply"

symptoms.symptom: Garments still wrinkled after steam cycle

causes.label: Too many garments
remedies: Load fewer garments; manually increase time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Too many garments"

symptoms.symptom: Garments are wet after Steam cycle

causes.label: Lint filter not clean
remedies: Clean lint filter
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Lint filter not clean"

symptoms.symptom: No numbers displayed during cycle, only lights

causes.label: Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes
remedies: This is normal.
When the dryer senses a low level of moisture in the load, the dryer will display the dry time remaining.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes"

symptoms.symptom: Time Remaining jumped to a lower number

causes.label: The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying"
